exams.name: American Red Cross Lifeguarding Certification
exams.blurb: Water rescue certification with written and in-water skills testing plus CPR/AED and first aid for professional rescuers.

exams.name: American Red Cross Lifeguarding Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Instructor course qualifying certified lifeguards to teach and evaluate Red Cross lifeguarding and first aid courses.

exams.name: American Red Cross Water Safety Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification qualifying candidates to teach Red Cross swim lessons and water safety courses to all age groups.

exams.name: NRA Certified Instructor
exams.blurb: Discipline-specific instructor training in pistol, rifle, shotgun, muzzleloading, personal protection and home firearm safety.

exams.name: NRA Chief Range Safety Officer
exams.blurb: Advanced course qualifying holders to train range safety officers and to develop range standard operating procedures.

exams.name: NRA Range Safety Officer
exams.blurb: Course and assessment covering range standard operating procedures, firing line commands, stoppages and emergency response.

exams.name: PSIA-AASI Level 1 Instructor Certification
exams.body: Professional Ski Instructors of America and American Association of Snowboard Instructors
exams.blurb: Entry snowsports instructor credential assessed on teaching, technical skiing or riding, and people skills for beginner lessons.

exams.name: PSIA-AASI Level 2 Instructor Certification
exams.body: Professional Ski Instructors of America and American Association of Snowboard Instructors
exams.blurb: Intermediate snowsports credential assessed on advanced terrain performance, movement analysis and intermediate lesson delivery.

exams.name: PSIA-AASI Level 3 Instructor Certification
exams.body: Professional Ski Instructors of America and American Association of Snowboard Instructors
exams.blurb: Highest snowsports teaching credential assessed on expert terrain skiing or riding, precise movement analysis and advanced coaching.

exams.name: AFAA Certified Personal Trainer
exams.body: Athletics and Fitness Association of America
exams.blurb: Personal training credential covering assessment, exercise technique, programme design and client communication fundamentals.

exams.name: AFAA Group Fitness Instructor Certification
exams.body: Athletics and Fitness Association of America
exams.blurb: Long-running group exercise credential covering class construction, movement analysis, cueing and injury prevention.

exams.name: PGA Associate Program
exams.blurb: Three-level education and testing pathway in golf operations, teaching and business leading to PGA membership.

exams.name: PGA Playing Ability Test
exams.blurb: Thirty-six hole one-day playing examination against a target score, required for entry to the PGA Associate Program.

exams.name: Precision Nutrition Level 1 Certification
exams.blurb: Self-paced nutrition coaching certification covering nutrition science, client assessment and habit-based behaviour change.

exams.name: Precision Nutrition Level 2 Master Health Coaching Certification
exams.blurb: Mentored advanced programme applying coaching psychology, client change frameworks and practice-building over a full year.

exams.name: USA Weightlifting Level 1 Coach Certification
exams.blurb: Two-day course and examination on snatch and clean and jerk technique, teaching progressions and basic programme design.

exams.name: USA Weightlifting Level 2 Coach Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced course covering periodisation, error correction, competition preparation and athlete management for weightlifting.

exams.name: Wilderness EMT Certification
exams.blurb: Wilderness upgrade for licensed EMTs covering extended patient care, environmental emergencies and technical evacuation.

exams.name: Wilderness First Responder Certification
exams.blurb: Multi-day course and testing in patient assessment, improvised care and evacuation decisions for remote backcountry settings.

exams.name: Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga Teacher 200
exams.blurb: Registry credential granted after a 200-hour registered school programme; Yoga Alliance registers teachers rather than testing them.

exams.name: Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga Teacher 500
exams.blurb: Advanced registry level requiring 500 hours of registered training plus documented teaching hours, with no central examination.

exams.name: Cooper Institute Personal Trainer Certification
exams.blurb: Research-based personal trainer credential emphasising cardiorespiratory fitness assessment and preventive exercise programming.

exams.name: Ellis & Associates International Lifeguard Training Program
exams.blurb: Aquatic risk management lifeguard programme widely used at waterparks, with skills auditing and unannounced performance checks.

exams.name: IHEA-USA Hunter Education Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Standards-based instructor training for volunteers teaching state hunter education courses in firearm safety and ethics.

exams.name: Leave No Trace Master Educator Course
exams.body: Leave No Trace Center for Outdoor Ethics
exams.blurb: Five-day field course qualifying outdoor professionals to teach Leave No Trace trainer courses and outdoor ethics curricula.

exams.name: NASBLA-Approved Boating Safety Education Certificate
exams.body: National Association of State Boating Law Administrators
exams.blurb: National standard for recreational boating safety courses, with certificates accepted reciprocally by most state agencies.

exams.name: NAUI Scuba Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Instructor training course and examination covering dive theory, teaching methodology, rescue skills and academic presentation.

exams.name: NCCPT Certified Personal Trainer
exams.body: National Council for Certified Personal Trainers
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited personal training examination covering anatomy, assessment, exercise technique and business fundamentals.

exams.name: NCSF Certified Personal Trainer
exams.body: National Council on Strength and Fitness
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited trainer credential emphasising exercise science, client screening and structured programme progression.

exams.name: NFHS Officials Certification Program
exams.body: National Federation of State High School Associations
exams.blurb: National courses and rules testing supporting state association registration of high school sports officials across sports.

exams.name: NFPT Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited trainer examination covering muscular anatomy, resistance training principles, nutrition basics and safety.

exams.name: NPCP Pilates Certification Examination
exams.blurb: Independent third-party examination establishing entry-level competence for comprehensively trained Pilates teachers.

exams.name: NSPA Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: Personal trainer credential combining exercise science coursework with practical coaching and assessment competencies.

exams.name: PTR Professional Tennis Teacher Certification
exams.blurb: Workshop and testing pathway for tennis coaches assessed on stroke production, teaching, group management and rules.

exams.name: SSI Open Water Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Instructor training and evaluation covering dive theory examinations, classroom teaching, pool skills and open water supervision.

exams.name: StarGuard ELITE Lifeguard Certification
exams.blurb: Aquatic safety certification for pools and waterparks emphasising surveillance, scanning strategy and rescue response auditing.

exams.name: TDI Technical Diver Certification
exams.blurb: Progressive technical diving credentials covering decompression procedures, gas blending, trimix and overhead environments.

exams.name: U.S. Soccer Grassroots Coaching License
exams.blurb: Introductory coaching licences by age format covering session design, player development and safe practice environments.
